t: Not much is left to see of the Queen's Theatre, which is now gone. It stood on the corner of Long Acre and Endell Street, in Covent Garden, with entrances in Wilson Street and Long Acre. It was established in 1867 on the site of St Martin's Hall, a large concert room that had opened in 1850. The sculptor Richard Westmacott designed it. He was a prominent English sculptor of the early and mid-nineteenth century, and he was sometimes called Richard Westmacott the third, to tell him apart from his father and grandfather, who shared the name.
